name: AAC Studio
subtitle: Picture-based communication for non-verbal children
description: Open-source AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) app: tap pictures to build sentences and speak them aloud. Modern flat pictures, offline voice, daily routines, skin tone choice.

apps.name: AAC Studio
apps.subtitle: Tap pictures, build sentences, speak them aloud.
apps.localizedDescription: AAC Studio helps children who cannot speak, or speak little, to communicate. Tap picture buttons to build a message and the app speaks it. Includes core words (I, want, help, yes, no, wait), categories, Daily routines, a calm-down page, a typing keyboard with word prediction and an offline voice. Caregivers can edit buttons and lock settings with a code.
